question: In a certain code language "MINAR" is coded as "10", and "QILA" is coded as 12. How will "TAJMAHAL" will written in same code language.
solution:
The position of letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/280edd38c28f654e5e585ad1955c316946c3734bdbb5e1e334358cc450a83ad4.png] 

**Logic: Addition of place value of all alphabet then sum of the given result.**

"MINAR" is coded as "10",

⇒ M(13) + I(9) + N(14) + A(1) + R(18) =** 55 ⇒ 5 + 5 = 10**

And,

"QILA" is coded as 12

⇒ Q(17) + I(9) + L(12) + A(1) = **39 ⇒ 3 + 9 = 12**

Similarly,

"TAJMAHAL" will written as '?'

⇒ T(20) + A(1) + J(10) + M(13) + A(1) + H(8) + A(1) + L(12) =** 66 ⇒ 6 + 6 = 12**

Hence, the correct answer is **"12"**
